topic: Large Language Models (LLMs) for Requirements Engineering (RE): A Systematic Literature Review
topic_definition: Stage 2 canonical eligibility, source-faithful to the original paper's screening criteria. Eligible studies are primary empirical studies using LLMs to support Requirements Engineering tasks, peer-reviewed, published as conference, workshop, or journal articles, and meeting the source review's venue-quality rules.
summary: Stage 2 canonical criteria restated from criteria_mds/2509.11446.md; publication-time fallback filtering is handled by cutoff_jsons/2509.11446.json.

summary_topics.description: Large Language Models (LLMs) for Requirements Engineering (RE): A Systematic Literature Review

required.criterion: Paper is a primary study that uses LLMs to support Requirements Engineering tasks.
Paper is published as a conference paper, workshop paper, or journal article.
Paper satisfies the venue quality filter: conference is CORE A*/A/B, journal is Q1/Q2, or workshop is associated with a CORE A*/A/B conference.

exclusion_criteria.criterion: Papers using LLMs but not for supporting Requirements Engineering tasks are excluded.
Short papers with fewer than 5 pages are excluded.
Conceptual papers without empirical evaluation are excluded.
